There is a $15.00 fee. Grant County Recorder Julie Fischer P.O. Box 258 Carson, ND 58529 email: jafische@nd.gov Katrina Hummel - Deputy email: kjhummel@nd.gov Recorder Telephone: (701) 622-3544 Fax: (701) 622-3717 The Recorder's duties as stated in North Dakota Century Code, shall keep full and true record, in proper books or other storage media provided, of each patent, deed, mortgage, bill of sale, security agreement, judgment, decree, lien, certificate of sale and other instruments required to be filed or admitted to record, if the person offering the instrument for filing or recording pays to the recorder the fees provided by law for the filing or recording. Grant County Recorder's office deals with the following: Land Ownership Records | UCC Filings | Homestead Records | Tax Liens | Deed Filings | Burial Transit Permits | Mortgage Filings | Wills | NORTH DAKOTA RECORDING REQUIREMENTS DOCUMENT MUST BE AN ORIGINAL or CERTIFIED COPY SIGNATURES: All SIGNATURES (there are exceptions depending upon the instrument) Must be ORIGINAL HANDWRITTEN signature(s) (NDCC 47-19-03 & 44-06-13.1 [1.]) (See statute for exceptions) All person(s) named in document (grantor, lessor, mortgagor, etc.) are the “ signatories ” and are also named in the acknowledgment If grantor is an ESTATE or TRUST, it is signed by personal representative(s) or trustee(s) before notary public NOTARY: Seal and Expiration Date must be easily readable and able to be scanned. ADEQUATE LEGAL DESCRIPTION (NDCC 11-18-05 [1][a.][3.] FONT SIZE Must be equal to or greater than 10 point CALIBRI font (NDCC 11-18-05 [1] [a.][2]) SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBERS – Must be redacted on the document DEEDS and Contracts for Deed - Additional Requirements STATEMENT OF FULL CONSIDERATION (not required on a deed covering minerals only) (NDCC 11-18-02.2) POST OFFICE ADDRESS for GRANTEE(S) (NDCC 47-19-05 & 47-10-07) NAME & ADDRESS OF DRAFTER on a deed or contract for deed executed 1-1-2000 or after containing a metes & bounds legal description (NDCC 47-19-03.1) All taxes must be paid before the Auditor’s Office w ill transfer the deed so we can record it. MORTGAGES - Additional Requirements _____ POST-OFFICE ADDRESS of the MORTGAGEE(S) (NDCC 35-03-04) _____ POST-OFFICE ADDRESS of the ASSIGNEE(S) (NDCC 35-03-04) NORTH DAKOTA RECORDING FEES (NDCC 11-18-05) Number of Pages $20.00 for one (1) to six (6) pages - $65.00 for seven (7) to twenty five (25) pages and $3.00 for each additional page for 26 or more pages Recording Space – Must have a 3” margin provided at the top of the first page of each instrument for the County Recorders’ recording information (i.e., recorder’s signature, recorder’s seal, barcode recording label). NDCC 11-18-05 [1][a.][4.] If no space an additional page shall be added and an additional page charge must be levied in accordance with the fee structure. More than ten (10) sections of land “listed” : $1.00 per section after the first ten (10) listed. NDCC 11-18-05 [1][b.] Reference BOOK/PAGE or DOCUMENT # of prior recorded document : $3.00 for each additional Book/Page or Document # referenced after the first ten (10) Book/Page or Document #s : NDCC 11-18-05 [1][b.] 1” Margin Requirement - No 1-inch margin on either the top , bottom , or one of the sides of each page additional $10.00 margin fee will be assessed See NDCC 11-18 for additional recording fees requirements Property Fraud Alert The Grant County Recorder's Office has teamed up with Fidlar Technologies to offer Property Fraud Alert. Property Fraud Alert is a FREE notification service that alerts subscribers (via email, text message, or a voice phone call) each time a document with their name is recorded in the Grant County Recorder's Office. To learn more about Property Fraud Alert and to sign up in Grant County (and other North Dakota counties), please click the Property Fraud Alert logo below. This website link also has tips on how to sign up with business, trust, and common names. If you would like assistance signing up, please call the Fidlar customer service specialists at the Property Fraud Alert Hotline: 1-800-728-3858. While Property Fraud Alert does not prevent fraud from happening, it provides an early warning system for property owners to take appropriate actions should they determine possible fraudulent activity has taken place.
